positive_rule: A handoff is valid only when the canonical resolver reads pmp-current-map-v12.json, resolves source_role route_guardian and destination_role current_app from that same map, and emits the exact map-issued destination with complete lineage fields.
fail_closed_rules: Reject missing or malformed handoff fields.
Reject a source role other than route_guardian.
Reject a destination role other than current_app.
Reject any destination not issued by pmp-current-map-v12.json.
Reject alternate-map, historical-map, hard-coded, saved-route, owner, pointer, or implicit fallback destinations.

preservation.claim_ceiling: Contract, deterministic source validation, and fail-closed tests only. No browser proof, real-app activation, route mutation, later Pass 3 unit, or later pass is claimed.

next_unit_not_started: Implement the smallest runtime consumer integration only after this contract unit is merged and re-read from main.
